description: This Java class 'CHeaderConsumer' implements 'ConfigurationConsumer' to generate C header files by writing appropriate boilerplate and structure-specific content to a BufferedWriter.

classes.name: CHeaderConsumer
classes.description: A class responsible for writing C header files based on configuration data, managing boilerplate comments, include guards, and handling end of structures.

methods.name: CHeaderConsumer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the consumer with a BufferedWriter for output.

methods.name: startFile
methods.description: Writes the initial section of the C header file, including comments, include guards, and necessary includes.

methods.name: endFile
methods.description: Writes the footer of the C header file, including closing the include guard.

methods.name: handleEndStruct
methods.description: Writes the end of a configuration structure to the header, utilizing the static headerWrite method of ConfigStructure.
